newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies 13 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies 13 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 13 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Mesa Unified School District No. 4, Ariz., $29.150 million school improvement bonds.
--Vallejo City USD, Calif., $30 million general obligation bonds.
--Baltimore, Md., $8.745 million public improvement (tax) bonds and $26.625 million public improvement bonds.
--Cumberland County, N.J., $2.932 million general improvement bonds.
--Montgomery County, N.Y., $4.875 million public improvement bonds.
--Washingtonville CSD, N.Y., $2.344 million school district bonds.
--Penn Higher Ed Facilities, Pa., $46.745 million revenue bonds as a direct purchase.
--Eagle Lake, Texas, $1 million certificates of obligation.
--Port Houston Auth., Texas, $28 million port improvement bonds.
--Arlington County, Va., $34.2 million public improvement GOs.
